sources.title: P&G cuts model deployment time up to 90% with Azure IoT Operations
sources.supports: supplier-reported named plant/edge ML deployment and process-time claim

financial_anchor.value: about $19.75bn GAAP operating income implied by the reported 22.7% operating margin; net earnings $16.1bn
financial_anchor.caveat: See dossier for implied/adjusted definition and confounders.

ai_claim.claim: P&G deployed Azure IoT Operations and edge predictive models; Microsoft reports up to 90% less time to deploy a model version.
ai_claim.stage: E2 supplier-reported deployment/process result; no E3 operational or cash outcome
ai_claim.scope: manufacturing edge models and workload orchestration
ai_claim.limitation: Supplier case study; deployment time is not OEE, downtime, quality or retained cash.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: FY2026 core operating margin fell 70bp and ordinary productivity, restructuring, mix, commodity/tariff and pricing actions confound any AI attribution

rights_limit: Customer, retailer, supplier and syndicated data are purpose-/contract-bound; scale is not universal pooled-training permission.
materiality_summary: about $987.5m annual pre-tax (5% of implied $19.75bn GAAP operating income)

arithmetic.formula: assumed $15bn eligible SG&A/supply cost × 10% efficiency × 60% realization × 40% retention − $250m = $110m

g2_provisional: Incomplete: production baseline without controlled incremental retained cash.
